newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends with small gains in erratic trade.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends with small gains in erratic trade.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL
May (3rd pos) 1,243 rgt/tonne Mar (south) 1,290
Open/Hi/Low 1,232/1,245/1,228 Prev close 1,282.50
Prev settlement 1,234 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - The market ended with small gains after an erratic session. Rises in soyoil and talk of supportive export data aided the market which saw more business in May futures. May futures is likely to trade between 1,220 and 1,250 which was broken last week. Trading was fairly volatile.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Interest was evident among selected oils with an absence of export business limiting activity.
"May futures had broken the psychological level of 1,250 ringgit last week and should rebound marginally," one said.

But according to a chartist, technically, the market is still bearish. "People may just let May futures drop further to more competitive levels in order to attract some export business," another trader said.
Gains in the soyoil futures last Friday aided sentiment.

"There were fresh buying and shortcovering after a mixed early morning, on talk of supportive export data for first 10 days of this month," a trader said. "I heard the first 10 days exports were estimated at around 160,000 tonnes. That's good."
"There were a lot of buying from 1,230 to 1,235 and then at 1,240 ringgit (May futures)," the trader said.
At the close, the May futures contract finished nine ringgit higher at 1,243 ringgit ($501.82) a tonne after trading in a 17-ringgit range.
Traders pegged the resistance level for May futures contract at 1,250 with support at 1,220.
But some traders said the upside would be capped as the underlying fundamentals were not strong.
"Production is seen picking up because the low seasonal output period is over and demand is also sluggish," a trader said.

Among physicals, Mar (south) crude palm ol was offered at 1,290 ringgit against bids of 1,285 after trading from 1,280 to 1,287.50. Mar (central) saw offers at 1,282.50 against bids of 1,277.50 with earlier trades done at 1,280 and 1277.50.
Apr (south) was offered at 1,82.50 with bids at 1,275 with transactions from 1,270 to 1,280, and Apr (central) at 1,275 with bids at 1,267.50.
Among refined products, Mar RBD palm oil was offered at $555 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Apr at $545 and May/June at $540. Apr was traded at $542.50 and $544.
Mar RBD palm olein saw offers at $585, Apr at $577.50 and May/Jun at $570. Mar was dealt at $582 and $581.
Mar RBD palm stearin was offered at $455 and Mar/Apr palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $310.
